endpoints.name: phone_system_getnumberpoollist
endpoints.description: List Number Pools Get list of number pools [GET /phone-system/number-pools] Token: location. Scopes: numberpools.read.

endpoints.name: phone_system_available_numbers
endpoints.description: List available phone numbers Search for available phone numbers to purchase for a specific location. Supports filtering by number pattern, type, and capabilities. [GET /phone-system/numbers/location/{locationId}/available] Token: location. Scopes: phonenumbers.read.

locationId.description: The unique identifier of the location

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for which to search available numbers

numberTypes.description: Comma-separated list of phone number types to search for (e.g. local, tollFree, mobile)

firstPart.description: Filter numbers that begin with this digit pattern

lastPart.description: Filter numbers that end with this digit pattern

anywhere.description: Filter numbers that contain this digit pattern anywhere

smsEnabled.description: Filter for numbers with SMS capability

mmsEnabled.description: Filter for numbers with MMS capability

voiceEnabled.description: Filter for numbers with voice capability

endpoints.name: phone_system_purchase_phone_number
endpoints.description: Purchase a phone number for a specific location. [POST /phone-system/numbers/location/{locationId}/purchase] Token: location. Scopes: phonenumbers.write.

locationId.description: The unique identifier of the location

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the number

bundleSid.description: Twilio bundle SID for regulatory compliance

locality.description: Locality where the number is being purchased

region.description: Region where the number is being purchased

fingerprintId.description: Unique request ID for idempotency (fingerprint of the purchase request)

skipLocationKYC.description: Skip location-level KYC verification if agency-level compliance has already been verified

endpoints.name: phone_system_active_numbers
endpoints.description: List active numbers Retrieve a paginated list of active phone numbers for a specific location. Supports filtering, pagination, and optional exclusion of number pool assignments. [GET /phone-system/numbers/location/{locationId}] Token: location. Scopes: phonenumbers.read.

locationId.description: The unique identifier of the location

searchFilter.description: Filter numbers by phone number pattern. Supports partial matching (e.g., "+91" to find all Indian numbers).
